edits.reason: Restore missing staffs without changing body poses.
Repaint six complementary whole-body poses after the first sheet repeated one lead leg. The guide contained temporary mirrored lower-body edits; it is never used as a sprite.
Paint the missing opposite passing pose separately. Preserve its reference canvas density, not the dimensions of a partial hair-colour mask.

delivery: clips.json selects six painted keys per view and their temporal order. Only the six top-level PNG sources and clips.json enter run_poses.py. Whole-image registration and the shared Rogue V2 raster tween build the final atlas offline. No cut-out rig or fallback exists. Source generation is not bitwise reproducible; runtime rebuild from these frozen sources is.
